# Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public API impact is stated.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or the lack of test changes is explained.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.
- [ ] No unsupported security claims were added.
- [ ] No heap or global mutable protocol state was introduced.
- [ ] No `Co-authored-by` trailers were added for AI tools or automated systems.
- [ ] Verification commands and results are included.
